concerns.text: Tasks T012b and T013b introduce 'molecular pathway data' (SCFA, BDNF, cytokines) and 'molecular marker alignment' which have no corresponding Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in spec.md. The spec strictly limits scope to microbiome (FR-001) and cognitive data (FR-002). These tasks represent unmandated scope creep with no spec anchor.

Tasks T021b (correlation with molecular markers) and T023b (mediation analysis) lack spec coverage. Spec FR-003/FR-005 define correlation/regression only between taxa and cognitive scores. There is no FR/SC for 'mediation analysis' or 'molecular markers' in the spec, making these tasks untraceable to requirements.

Task T032b ('Mechanistic Pathway Diagram') has no corresponding spec requirement. Spec FR-007 only mandates a heatmap and forest plot. The diagram visualizes the unmandated molecular mediation hypothesis, creating a task with no spec anchor.

Task T036b (updating requirements for 'mediation' packages) is dependent on the unmandated mediation analysis tasks (T023b). Since the underlying analysis has no spec coverage, this dependency task also lacks a spec anchor.

Task T007 (Configure pytest) is marked as incomplete `[ ]` but is a foundational prerequisite for all test tasks (T008-T037). While the task exists, its incomplete status blocks the execution of the entire testing strategy defined in the plan. This is a coverage gap for the 'testing' element of the plan.

Task T015 (outlier filtering) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete) but is required to produce `data/qc/filtering_log.json` referenced by Constitution Principle VI and Plan.md. The task exists but is not yet actionable, creating a gap in the 'Data Hygiene' implementation coverage.

Task T016 (schema validation) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The plan requires `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` to be generated before T011 runs. The task exists but is incomplete, leaving the data validation element of the plan unimplemented.
